summary: Episodes 66-71 are six consecutive, faithful canon rows covering PRINTED chapters 233-253 (v25 tail through v27) with no skipped material: 66 = 233-236(opening), 67 = 236-239, 68 = 240-242, 69 = 242-246, 70 = 246-249 (+ an unquantified 250 tail the fandom alone records), 71 = 250-253(opening). Every value is in the PRINTED 1-348 space, and the wave-14 contract's stated conversion did NOT have to be applied to the fandom in this range: dragonquest.fandom's per-episode `adapted` field is ALREADY the printed number here, so 'fandom N >= 208 = printed N - 1' (ruling N35) is wrong for this stretch and has already produced three off-by-one stored anchors (eps 57, 58, 59), repaired below with evidence. Proof: (a) coco13's per-episode range is given as volume + chapter TITLE, and every title resolves through en-WP's volume list (list N = printed N + 1 for N >= 123) to exactly the fandom's number — ep 62 opens on the chapter its own title names, 破邪の洞窟 = printed 221 = the fandom's '221'; (b) the fandom's ep-57 field lists six consecutive numbers 204,205,206,207,208,209, which the ruled shift would collapse onto 207 twice — an arithmetic impossibility. All six target rows stay canon (faithfulness clause, T28): coco13's cut/addition lists are line-level studio beats inside adapted chapters. Four straddles take a `partial`; ep 70's END is held at 249 under A47 because only one of three sources places it inside 250, which ep 71 starts on.

structure.notes: CHAPTER SPACE — every number in this file is the PRINTED tankobon numbering (1-348), per the wave-14 contract. Conversions actually applied: (1) en-WP's volume list / AniList / MU / MangaDex number the unnumbered 番外編 勇者アバン as their 122, so their N >= 123 = printed N - 1 — applied to EVERY en-WP title lookup in this file (e.g. en-WP 234 ロン・ベルクの秘密 = printed 233; en-WP 254 最後の一太刀!!! = printed 253). Checked against the stored volume table at four boundaries: en-WP v23 = list 208-216 = printed 207-215 (stored v23 207-215), v24 = list 217-226 = printed 216-225 (stored 216-225), v25 = list 227-236 = printed 226-235 (stored 226-235), v26 = list 237-246 = printed 236-245 (stored 236-245), v27 = list 247-255 = printed 246-254 (stored 246-254). (2) coco13.club's per-episode 原作 range is given as volume + chapter TITLE (and, for eps 55-60, volume + NUMBER); its numbers are PRINTED — coco13 ep 57 calls 不屈の勇者・ダイ '208話' where en-WP lists it as 209, coco13 ep 56 calls 天かける不死鳥 '201話' where en-WP lists 202. No conversion needed on coco13. (3) THE CONTRACT'S THIRD CONVERSION DOES NOT APPLY HERE: dragonquest.fandom's per-episode `adapted` field is ALREADY in the printed space in this range, so 'fandom N >= 208 = printed N - 1' (ruling N35) must NOT be applied to eps 54-97. Two decisive proofs. (a) COLLISION: the fandom's ep-57 field lists six consecutive numbers '204 (partial), 205, 206, 207, 208, 209 (1 panel)'; the ruled shift maps its 207 -> 207 and its 208 -> 207, which cannot be a coverage list. (b) TITLE TEST: the fandom's ep-62 field is '221, 222, 223 (partial)' and coco13 says ep 62 OPENS on 破邪の洞窟, which is en-WP list 222 = printed 221 — i.e. the fandom's '221' IS printed 221; under the shift the episode would open on 起てよ勇者 (printed 220) and reach its own title chapter only as a closing partial. The same test passes on every episode 54-97 I checked (54, 55, 56, 58, 59, 60, 62, 63, 64, 65, 66-71, 74, 75, 77, 78, 79, 91, 93, 94, 95, 96): the fandom's number equals the printed number that coco13's TITLE resolves to. The fandom's own chapter PAGES are printed too (chapter 122 = 決勝戦の異変!! vol 14, chapter 196 = さらば我が子よ vol 21) — they simply stop existing above 201, which is presumably why wave 13 had to infer the shift arithmetically. WHERE THE FANDOM DOES GAIN +1: its ep-100 field ends at '349', one past printed 348, and the coco13 title test flips between eps 97 and 98 — ep 97's fandom field starts on 335 = 瞳の中の奇蹟 (printed, correct) but ep 98's '339 (partial), 340, 341, 342, 343 (partial)' matches coco13's 心をひとつに(printed 338)の序盤 → 咆哮(printed 342)の序盤 only under a -1. So the fandom's episode fields are PRINTED through ~ep 97 and run +1 from ~ep 98; the 96-100 sub-block must re-derive that seam row by row, and the ep-100 MU pin (348 v37) is unaffected by it. ROW-IDENTITY: our rows 66-71 match dragonquest.fandom, Toei and coco13 on title AND air date one-for-one (66 = 五色の光 2022-01-22 … 71 = 真竜の闘い 2022-02-26); no renumbering anywhere in this block. COVERAGE: eps 66-71 cover printed 233-253 with no gap and no skipped chapter, so no C2/C3 skip note is needed inside the sub-block. FENCE: the lower fence (ep 59 -> 216) is repaired UP to 217 above; sub-block A's rows 60-65 then run printed 217-232 (fandom fields 217-220, [ep 61 = the vol-13 番外編], 221-223, 223-226, 226-229, 229-232 — all already printed), which hands cleanly to my ep 66 START of 233.
